title: Sharp Realizability of Propensity-Calibrated Divergence Ambiguity Classes by a Single Structural Model
banked_reason: Re-tiered from accepted on 2026-09-09: fully proved in Lean and originally accepted at field tier, but re-scored 6.4 under the recalibrated D0.5.G scale, below the 7.2 field bar; the mathematics was not refuted.
gap_reasons: The promised itbound/IHDP legality application has been replaced by a conditional generic cap correction: the core itself leaves the program's support convention unaudited, so it supplies no source-audited software deliverable.
proof_attempt_summary: The run proved fixed-stratum bow-mixture completeness, the affine-invariant generator exactness frontier, open illegal regions for every failing generator, sharp CDF endpoints, heterogeneous-propensity impossibility, and simultaneous finite-sample endpoint bands. Discovery repaired a false all-n tie-contact formulation to an eventual-tail statement, while formalization repaired generator-domain and support-regime scaffold mismatches; all 70 delivered targets ultimately matched under both F4 reviewers with no source placeholders or project axioms. The proposed source-specific itbound/IHDP software correction was removed because the implementation convention was not audited; the accepted result retains the generic lawful cap correction instead.
tldr: The field-level result lifts the propensity frontier to one covariate-conditioned global SCM: measurable residual kernels characterize exactly the jointly realizable interventional kernels on a common covariate-conull set, in both the one-sided and reverse-support regimes, and the jointly Borel adaptive hinge recovers these classes fiber by fiber without integrating the divergence over covariates. At a fixed propensity, the affine-invariant generator iff remains exact, while no single fixed generator can be universally exact at two distinct propensities. Sharp CDF endpoints and simultaneous inference remain fixed-stratum consequences.
gap: Jung and Kang prove that every compatible interventional law belongs to a propensity-calibrated ambiguity class and optimize exactly over that class, yielding valid outer causal bounds; they do not establish that every ambiguity-class member is realizable by a bow SCM. Robust-statistics and information-theory papers separately provide contamination neighborhoods, hinge divergences, density bands, and finite-alphabet reductions, but none identifies all ordinary convex generators whose calibrated class exactly equals the bow-SCM law class or proves an open illegal region for every failure.
fill: The propensity-hinge iff is the sole flagship. Bow-SCM mixture completeness supplies its structural input, and the nondifferentiability-robust binary open-gap theorem supplies its stable converse, including explicit KL and hinge certificates. Sharp CDF and bounded-query formulas, distribution-free confidence bands, and the shared software cap are consequences and implementation layers.
